name: expocut
description: Connect Claude Code to the ExpoCut video editor on your phone over local Wi-Fi: 260+ MCP tools to build, review and export videos, plus ExpoCut's editing skills.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Shown in ExpoCut → Settings → AI Agent (MCP Server), for example http://192.168.1.20:7333/mcp. The phone and this computer must be on the same Wi-Fi.

token.title: Bearer Token
token.description: Shown next to the Server URL in ExpoCut. Stored in your system credential store. Tap Rotate in the app to revoke it.

auto_discover.title: Find the phone automatically when its address changes
auto_discover.description: When the Server URL stops answering, scan this computer's local subnet for ExpoCut. The token is only sent to a host that identifies itself as ExpoCut.
